faq: Do you take the product photos?
No. You send photos or we use images from your supplier that you have rights to use. If the photos are weak, we tell you what to reshoot before we spend time on design.
Can you create lifestyle scenes with people?
We use scenes you supply or that come from licensed stock, composed with your product. We never show a product doing something it cannot do, and we do not invent reviews or awards.
What are Amazon's main image rules?
A pure white background, the product filling most of the frame, no text, logos or badges on the main image, and a minimum size so zoom works. We check each file against these rules.
Will you upload the images for me?
Yes, to your listings, if you want. Otherwise we send named files in the right order with notes on which slot each goes in, and you upload them.
desc:
Amazon listing images and infographics show shoppers what the product is before they read a word. Ecom Swift LLC prepares your main image on pure white, feature and size infographics and lifestyle graphics, sized and checked against Amazon's image rules.

## Why do Amazon listing images matter so much?

On Amazon, the image is the first thing a shopper sees in search results and the main thing they study on the product page. People cannot touch the item, so they judge quality, size and use from pictures alone. If the pictures are dark, cluttered or confusing, many shoppers move on without reading the title.

Images also affect how the product is accepted. Amazon sets strict rules for the main image, and a file that breaks them can be removed from the listing or cause the listing to be suppressed.

## How images shape clicks and conversions

Two moments decide a sale. The first is the click from the search page, where the main image competes with several others. A clean, well-lit product on a white background is easy to read at a small size and signals that the listing is serious.

The second moment is the decision on the product page. The extra images answer the questions a shopper would ask in a shop: how big is it, what is it made of, how is it used, what is in the box. Infographics place that information on the image so it is read at a glance, including on a phone. Results depend on price, reviews and competition, and we make no promise about sales.

## What a strong Amazon image set includes

- A main image on a pure white background, with the product filling most of the frame.
- A feature infographic that names the top benefits in short phrases.
- A size and dimensions image that uses simple callouts.
- A how-to-use or in-use image that shows the product working.
- A lifestyle composition built from scenes you supply or license.
- A comparison chart image for related products in your range.
- A readable layout on a phone screen, with text large enough to scan.
- File sizes and names prepared for upload.
- Editable source files where the package includes them.

## What we create

We start with the product photos you send and review them for sharpness, light and angle. We clean and cut out the product for the main image, and design the infographics using your brand colors and fonts. Where you provide or license scenes, we compose lifestyle graphics around the product.

Every file is sized for Amazon and checked against the image rules before delivery. The Basic, Standard and Premium packages grow from a main image with one infographic, to a full seven-image set for one product, to sets for three products in one matching style. We do not add fake badges, invented claims or review quotes. You can upload the files yourself, or invite us to do it in your account.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Send the sharpest, highest-resolution photos you have.
- Keep infographic text short and large.
- Show the product at true scale next to a familiar object.
- Use the same style across every product in a range.
- Check the images on a phone before you publish.

**Avoid:**
- Adding logos, borders, watermarks or text to the main image.
- Using badges such as best seller that Amazon has not given you.
- Showing accessories that are not included in the box.
- Copying lifestyle pictures from another brand.
- Placing dense paragraphs of text on an image.

## Who this is for

This service suits a seller whose supplier photos look dull and who needs a clean main image. It also suits a brand launching a new product that needs a full set of seven images. A business with a range of related products can use the matching style and comparison chart to make every page feel like one brand.

## What we need from you

Please send your product photos, brand colors, logo and a short list of the features and sizes to show. If you want lifestyle scenes, send photos you own or have a licence to use. We never need passwords, and if you want us to upload, you invite us as a user in your Seller Central account.
